title: Welcome to your artifact hub
summary: A sample page built from artifact.json. Your agent writes pages like this one from plans, reviews and research, publishes them to your own Cloudflare Pages site, and reads your feedback back from the page.

sections.title: What this page is
paragraphs: Every artifact is a folder in your artifacts root. The source is `artifact.json`. The build turns it into a self-contained `index.html` for people and an `artifact.md` twin for agents, which costs them far less to read.
Agents edit the JSON, never the HTML. The validator rebuilds the page and refuses to publish anything that doesn't match its source.

cards.title: 1. Comment on a block
cards.detail: Tap Comment (bottom left), then any paragraph, card or task, and write a note. Notes stay in your browser.

cards.title: 2. Copy feedback
cards.detail: Copy feedback turns your notes into one block, and each note names the block's stable anchor. Paste it into your agent.

cards.title: 3. The agent updates the page
cards.detail: The agent finds each anchor in artifact.json, makes the edit, then rebuilds, validates and republishes. With comments turned on, threads are saved on the site and the agent replies and resolves them itself.
